scenarios.name: Vision model ready
scenarios.description: Vision model selected; image control visible, audio control hidden, and transcript empty.

scenarios.name: Text-only model
scenarios.description: Text-only model selected; image and audio controls absent, with the standard text prompt ready.

scenarios.name: Image inference complete
scenarios.description: JPG attached and vision response returned; inline image thumbnail and assistant text visible.

scenarios.name: Audio inference complete
scenarios.description: ASR AI Asset selected, MP3 attached, transcription shown, and assistant response returned.

scenarios.name: No ASR AI Asset
scenarios.description: Audio-capable model selected; audio control visible but submission blocked by no-ASR-asset guidance.

scenarios.name: Oversized image rejected
scenarios.description: 12.4 MB PNG rejected before upload; persistent size-limit error and no file badge shown.

scenarios.name: One multimodal file limit
scenarios.description: Conversation already contains an image; a second image or audio upload is blocked with a one-file limit alert.

scenarios.name: ASR asset available
scenarios.description: AI Asset list loaded; one endpoint is marked ASR-capable and available to Playground.

scenarios.name: No AI Assets
scenarios.description: No AI Assets are registered; empty state explains how to connect an ASR endpoint.

scenarios.name: No ASR capability
scenarios.description: AI Assets are registered but none is marked ASR-capable; table and guidance reflect the missing capability.

scenarios.name: ASR capability saved
scenarios.description: Whisper Micro asset is marked ASR-capable and a persistent save-success alert is visible.

scenarios.name: AI Asset load error
scenarios.description: AI Asset Endpoints cannot be loaded; persistent error alert and retry action are visible.
